# Nikos Amofa

> Application analyst and cybersecurity practitioner. Founder of Watusoft Solutions, a Microsoft 365 security advisory for small and mid-sized law firms in NJ and NY.

Nikos Amofa works as an Application Analyst at one of the world's largest law firms, focused on vendor risk reviews of AI platforms, access governance, and M365 security operations. He holds ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity, CompTIA Security+, CompTIA CySA+, and CompTIA PenTest+ and an M.S. in Cybersecurity & Information Assurance from WGU, and is pursuing CISM. He is building a public GRC engineering portfolio focused on compliance automation for FedRAMP 20x, NIST 800-53 and AI governance.

He writes The Operator's Notebook, a monthly newsletter covering cybersecurity lessons from inside an enterprise environment and transparent updates on building Watusoft Solutions.

## Business

- [Watusoft Solutions](https://watusoft.com): M365 security audits and hardening for small and mid-sized law firms in NJ and NY. ABA Rule 1.6 aligned, cyber-insurance ready. 5–10 day engagements starting at $4,500.

## GRC engineering portfolio

- [FedRAMP 20x evidence pipeline](https://github.com/n2bright/fedramp-20x-evidence-pipeline): automated KSI evidence from AWS mapped to NIST 800-53, with POA&M export
- [Vulnerability management program](https://github.com/n2bright/vuln-mgmt-program): Tenable scanning, scripted remediation and POA&M tracking mapped to RA-5, SI-2 and CA-5
- [AI control-mapping assistant](https://github.com/n2bright/grc-control-mapper-ai): evidence-to-control mapping with citations and measured accuracy
- [M365 continuous compliance](https://github.com/n2bright/m365-continuous-compliance): CISA SCuBA baselines mapped to CIS and NIST 800-53
